heroSub: In the discrete manufacturing traceability system implemented at NEMAK's factory in Cigli (Izmir), semi-finished products are tracked throughout the entire manufacturing and logistics process.
contextTitle: Semi-finished product movements in the foundry industry
contextP1: NEMAK's factory in Cigli (Izmir) produces parts for the automotive supply industry using the casting method. In the discrete manufacturing traceability system implemented at this factory, semi-finished products are tracked throughout the entire manufacturing and logistics process.
contextP2: In discrete manufacturing, instantly controlling the logistics movements and storage status of each part is critical to increasing operational efficiency and preventing losses.
problemLede: In the discrete manufacturing structure, it was necessary to track semi-finished products throughout the manufacturing and logistics process, knowing which part was in which container at every stage. Manual tracking of this relationship carried the risk of traceability gaps and inefficiency in container movements; the process needed real-time visibility.

problemList.text: Inability to know in real time which part is in which transport container.
Accumulated or wrongly routed containers causing disruptions in the warehouse flow.

solutionTitle: Real-time web control with Datamatrix matching
solutionLede: A Datamatrix code is marked on each product; parts are scanned and linked to their respective containers as they move between operations. This ensures precise tracking of each container while allowing efficient transport of accumulated containers to the warehouse. The entire flow can be monitored in real time through the system, providing full transparency and operational control.

steps.title: Datamatrix Marking
steps.text: Produced parts are marked with a permanent Datamatrix code after casting.

steps.title: Container Linking
steps.text: As parts are loaded into containers, their codes are read and matched with the container ID.

steps.title: Route Verification
steps.text: The container route is verified through the parts scanned during transitions between operations.

steps.title: Web SCADA Monitoring
steps.text: All movements and fill rates are tracked instantly from web-based SCADA dashboards.

techTitle: Vision equipment and Web SCADA structure

techGrid.title: Industrial Code Readers
techGrid.text: Field hardware capable of reading Datamatrix codes on metal surfaces in harsh foundry conditions.

techGrid.title: PLC Field Management
techGrid.text: Control units managing code reading triggers and configurations.

techGrid.title: Web SCADA Interface
techGrid.text: Browser-independent user screens where instant production and container movements are displayed.

techGrid.title: OnSuite Trace Infrastructure
techGrid.text: Core software maintaining part-container matching and enabling logistics traceability.

integrationDesc: The application operates integrated with the NEMAK Global MES (Manufacturing Execution System). Part traceability data and container movements collected from the field are directly transmitted to the global MES system.

integrationList.text: Production approvals and logistics movements are instantly synchronized to NEMAK's global management system.

resultsGrid.title: Part-Container Mapping
resultsGrid.text: Part tracking is made precise by clearly knowing which container holds each semi-finished product.

resultsGrid.title: Transportation Optimization
resultsGrid.text: Thanks to the detection of accumulated containers, transport operations to the warehouse are run in a planned manner.

resultsGrid.title: Real-Time Visibility
resultsGrid.text: With Web SCADA screens, production and warehouse movements can be monitored instantly from anywhere.
